sources.data: Final supplement supplied by user. All 19 Table S1 P-V-lattice rows, all printed errors and all 57 xyzU site entries are preserved. Figure 1 includes an ambient point not tabulated in this supplement. No ambient observation, V0 or confidence convention is inferred.
sources.calibration: Mao, Xu and Bell (1986) ruby fluorescence, reference 13; neon medium. Pressure errors from before/after measurements, not declared standard deviations.
sources.qualification: Litasov Table 2 explicitly recalibrates comparison papers; its V0=154.2 must not be silently assigned to the original Prescher fit. The supplement resolves access to observations and high-pressure structures, but does not resolve the missing published V0 values. Table S1 reports 47.4 GPa maximum and R1=8.2% at 25.3 GPa despite the main text rounding to 47 GPa and stating R1 better than 8%.

supplement.volume_basis: Angstrom cubed per conventional orthorhombic Fe3C cell; Z=4
supplement.uncertainty: Parenthesized last-digit widths, confidence unspecified. Main paper defines pressure error from before/after ruby difference.

sources.access_history: Table S1 exists but was inaccessible through APS supplemental endpoints (401); link.aps.org redirected to a subscription-required page. Local Zotero and author-site copies contained only the four-page main paper.

author_archive_investigation.finding: Four EOS/diffraction workbooks, two Origin projects and 24 manuscript drafts inspected. Working reductions differ from final Table S1. No final three-fit output or source V0 constraint recovered; published observations and coefficients unchanged.

sources.authority: Final published article, Equations 1-6, Tables 1-2; official supplemental workbook
sources.reported_error_meaning: Last-digit errors in separate columns, as printed; confidence not specified. XLSX number formats are required: P5=121.30 with Q5=(8) means 0.08 A3, not 0.8 A3.
sources.calibration: KBr B2 Dewaele (2012), MgO Kono (2010), or pyrite-SiO2 Kuwayama (2011) for the ten highest-pressure 300 K rows; paired marker volumes retained.
sources.source_equation: BM3 300 K plus integrated-Gruneisen MGD; n=4 atoms per Fe3C formula, Z=4, theta0 fixed to 314 K, gamma=gamma0*(V/V0)^q, theta=theta0*exp((gamma0-gamma)/q).
source_qualifications: Workbook contains a 2600 K row although the main text says 2450 K maximum. Keep it; no source exclusion documented.
Figure 3 caption reverses dotted/dashed temperature naming relative to its legend. The visible 300 K density is higher than 5000 K at each P.
The KBr and MgO fits are pressure-scale variants of the same observations, not independent experiments. No automatic pressure conversion is authorized.
Standalone source models are staged outside the catalog; high-pressure magnetic-state/structure integration and exact fit workflow remain open.
